account_name: Apurv Singh | AI-First Marketing Educator and Growth Architect
caption:
Most marketers are still using AI like a chatbot.

The leverage was never in better prompts. 

It’s in plugging AI directly into the tools where your data already lives.

Three connectors worth turning on this week:

→ Motion. Shows which ad creatives are scaling and which are starting to fatigue.

→ Supermetrics. Pulls Meta, Google, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo into one natural-language query.

→ Contentsquare. Surfaces the page errors quietly killing your conversions.

The marketers who’ll have an edge over the next two years won’t be the ones with the cleverest prompts.

They’ll be the ones who built AI into their stack instead of treating it as a tab they switch to.

If you want the full guide with use cases and the exact prompts I run, comment ‘connectors’ below and I’ll send it across.
